name: com.linwei.tool.ui.network.HttpLogDetailsActivity
description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when a user selects an HTTP record in its network-report list. It shows the address, response status, timing, headers, and request and response data, and offers sharing or deleting the record.
disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's HTTP request and response detail, sharing, and deletion screen.
